title: Multiple universes
note: Machine config separates checkout registrations by connection. Selection follows --env, YOKE_ENV, the deepest registered checkout, a unique registered project reference, then active_env. Admin registrations select the ordinary paired connection implicitly; explicit overrides reach the admin door. Equal-depth matches on unrelated connections refuse checkout_connection_ambiguous. Git credentials select YOKE_ENV, deepest checkout, then active_env; an explicit checkout mismatch or ambiguous registration refuses before reading credentials and teaches environment or registration repair without reconnecting GitHub. Source tests cover routing; no live multi-universe proof is claimed.
